title.rendered: Arqaam Capital plays a new role as advisor and liquidity provider for Investcorp Capital

content.rendered:
Delighted to announce Arqaam Capital’s new role as advisor and liquidity provider for Investcorp Capital, leveraging our strengths in emerging markets to foster growth and stability
